bullets.text: People in Thiruvallur confronted a TVK MLA, forcing the politician to escape through the back door.
Two youth died of electrocution in Thiruvallur while erecting a banner for Udhayanidhi Stalin's birthday.
Two DMK youth wing functionaries died from an electric shock while putting up a banner in Thiruvallur.
Allegations of illegal gravel sand mining involving several lakh cubic metres have arisen in Gummidipoondi.
A lorry carrying liquor bottles worth 56 lakh rupees overturned near Avadi, causing a major accident.
Thiruvallur police arrested a person for selling liquor bottles illegally in Thiruttani town.
Chennai Mayor announced legal action over a deepfake AI-generated video circulated by TVK members.
Hindustan Zinc and IIT Madras achieved a major breakthrough in zinc-air battery technology in Chennai.
A modern MRI scan centre equipped with AI technology was opened at MGM Healthcare Malar Hospital in Adyar.
Chennai Mayor Priya warned TVK members strongly after her image was vulgarly morphed using artificial intelligence.
DMK criticized CM Vijay, alleging that AI-driven corruption claims reflect a failure to realize he is no longer in the opposition.
